Music for your business

Get Soundtrack: the premium streaming service built to bring great music to your business.

Try for freeContact sales

Excellent music for every company

Experience an unbeatable music service, developed to benefit businesses of any size. Use a top quality music streaming platform, enhanced with a range of professional tools. Choose from more than 125 million songs and over 2,500 playlists, licensed for business use.

Try for freeOur plans

Sound great

Use the greatest music discovery tools on offer: play from 2,500+ ready-made playlists or create your own, track by track. Access instant AI-powered playlist generation or hire our talented music experts to craft your ideal company soundtrack.

Try for free

Take control

Keep control of the music at every moment: on-site or on the go, the Soundtrack apps bring the power into your hands. Set your schedule ahead of time, react to the moment by making changes to the music or instantly block explicit lyrics.

Try for free

Save time

Manage your music admin with ease: oversee or amend activity in all of your locations from the centralized dashboard. Make the music work for you and share access with chosen colleagues or make the most of remote control capabilities.

Try for free

92%

of businesses find that the right music leads to longer stays and higher customer spend

*Source: Sound Strategies: How Licensed, Curated Music is Building Better Brand Experiences - TrendCandy, 2024.

Based on survey of 150 brand leaders in the US, commissioned by Soundtrack.

Get a Soundtrack setup that suits you. From apps to hardware, the choice is yours.

Learn more

Get legal

Personal music services such as Spotify are not approved to use in any business environment. You need to use a suitable music provider and have the correct licenses in place to avoid legal concerns.Soundtrack is a game changer: made to bring you music that's legal for your business, without compromising on quality. Simply add public performance licenses from your local collecting societies.

Sign upLicensing

Music creators

It's essential that each and every music creator is paid correctly. Soundtrack ensures that all song plays are tracked and reported. Each subscription generates up to 5X more than personal services.
